title: route
description: Deterministic cheapest priced path between two graph nodes at a stated time (Dijkstra over graph_edge, latest trip_pricing rates at or before at_time, CLOSED edges excluded). Design: docs/agent-tools-spec.md §2; version enforced by tests/test_tool_schemas.py.

origin.description: Origin node_id slug, e.g. 'i95x:garrisonville'. Must come from the graph_node list.

at_time.description: Required ISO-8601 instant; prices use the latest interval at or before this time. Prices are dynamic and the express lanes are reversible, so a quote is only meaningful against a stated time — pass the current UTC time for a 'right now' answer. Use the clock reading you were given; never guess it.

price_usd.description: Exact decimal as string; '0.00' for free junction connectors.

link_status.description: link_status of the priced row; null for free connectors (no trip_pricing row exists).

priced_at.description: interval_end_at of the priced row; null for free connectors.

oldest_priced_at.description: Oldest interval_end_at used anywhere in the path — how stale the quote could be. Null only for all-free paths. This is the staleness signal: prices are looked up at or before at_time with no lower bound, so a value far from at_time means the poller had a gap, not that the price is current.

error.description: Unknown node, or no open path exists (CLOSED edges are not traversable).

valid_nodes.description: The full node_id list, included so the model can correct the slug without another round trip.
